name: Pedrosa del Páramo (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a blue triangle at the upper fly and a red triangle at the lower hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pedrosa del Páramo (a castle, a column, a haystack and a sheep).
history: Municipal flag of Pedrosa del Páramo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pedrosa del Páramo arms — castle, column, haystack and sheep
